curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can two people build a genuine future together when they know from the start that time is running out?
curatedMovie.description: Seeking a fresh start after heartbreak, Hilary O'Neil takes a job as private nurse to a young man with blood cancer. As an intimate bond slowly forms, both must confront the reality of his illness.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Slow, thoughtful, and emotionally heavy. An engaged romantic drama suited for quiet solitary evenings or serious date nights.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Joel Schumacher directs an emotionally heavy, patient drama anchored in the bittersweet friction between budding romance and inevitable mortality.
